## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and final behavior. Link the issue.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Include relevant manual checks and screenshots using fictional data.

## Shared interfaces and limitations

Note contract, dependency, or permission changes and any remaining limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; unrun checks are explicitly identified.
- [ ] Shared contracts and docs are consistent with the change.
- [ ] No real applicant data, credentials, or generated artifacts are included.
